settings.question: How much does shipping cost and when will my mag arrive?
settings.answer:
Shipping is a flat $9.95 anywhere in Australia, and it's free once your cart hits $40.

We post within a couple of days of your order (we get a lot of them). From there it's standard AusPost - usually a few days to most places, a little longer for the more remote corners.

settings.question: What's the difference between a print and a digital mag?
settings.answer:
Same 120+ pages of kid-made creativity, two ways to enjoy it.

Print is the real thing - sustainably printed in Australia and posted to your letterbox.

Digital is the full magazine as a PDF, landing in your inbox within minutes. Perfect for travelling, sharing with grandparents, or reading on a screen.

settings.question: Can I still buy an issue that's sold out?
settings.answer:
This is where digital saves the day. Print runs are incredibly expensive, so we only print once - when they're gone, they're gone.

The good news? Every sold-out issue is still available to read digitally.

settings.question: Should I buy single issues or a Membership?
settings.answer:
If you just want to dip in, grab a single issue.

If your kid's hooked (most are), a Membership is the move - they never miss a drop, they're among the first to get the new mag, and you save a few dollars per issue. Choose 4 issues, 8 issues, or a Rolling Membership that renews before each drop.

settings.question: How can I pay?
settings.answer: Card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Shop Pay - whatever's easiest. Checkout is secure and you don't need an account.

settings.question: Do you ship outside Australia?
settings.answer:
Our printed mags post within Australia only for now.

Living overseas? The digital version reads anywhere in the world, so you can still get every issue.
